# Momentum Continuation — V2 Logic Improvement Specs (consolidated, v2)

**Status: locked for v1 implementation.** This is the single document to hand to Claude Code — it
folds together the logic spec, the L1/L2/L3 architecture and rationale, and the dashboard row copy
spec, which previously lived in three separate files. Those three files
(`Momentum_Continuation_V2_Architecture_L1_L2_L3.md`, `Momentum_Continuation_V2_Dashboard_Message_Copy.md`)
remain in the project as a changelog of how we got here, but this is the one doc that needs reading
to build v1.

Screening only; no trade execution logic. Data: Tiingo daily OHLCV with adjusted close.
Streamlit/Python app. Targets `src/rules_engine.py` / `src/data_engine.py` per
`SwingDeck_Context_Brief.md`.

Naming: **L1 structural bull** (gate), **L2 daily signal**, **L3 weekly confirmation score**. Earlier
project notes used "trigger" for L2 and numbered L2/L3 the other way round — see Part B for the full
renumbering history. This doc uses only the current, final names.

# Part A — Core logic

## 1. Config (single block, all values tunable without code changes)

```python
MC = dict(
    L1_SMA_WEEKS=50, L1_LOOKBACK_WEEKS=4, L1_MIN_WEEKS=54,
    L2_ATR_N=14, L2_ATR_K=1.5, L2_EMA_FAST=8, L2_EMA_SLOW=21,
    L2_STOCH=(14, 3, 3), L2_ZONE=30, L2_GRACE=3,
    ARMED_MAX_AGE=5,                       # sessions after the signal day (signal day = age 0)
    L3_MIN_WEEKS=40, L3_STOCH=(14, 3, 3), L3_RSI_N=14, L3_MACD=(12, 26, 9),
    L3_STOCH_FLOOR=20, L3_W_STOCH=2, L3_W_RSI=2, L3_W_MACD=1, L3_QUALIFY_MIN=4,
    FLAT_ZONE=30, FLAT_TOL=5, FLAT_PRIOR_FALL=5,
)
```

**New for this consolidation — see Part C's "Implementation requirement" for the full rationale:**
add an **`L2_MIN_SESSIONS`** constant (pin the exact number; "~60" in Part B is a starting point, not
final) plus a coded check that produces a real third output for L2, the same shape as L1's
`NOT_EVALUABLE` below. This is required for the dashboard copy in Part C to render correctly for
newly-listed tickers — it is not optional.

## 2. Data preparation
- Scale O/H/L/C by `AdjClose / Close` per row so all prices are split/dividend adjusted. Drop rows that are dividend/split markers or have no prices. De-duplicate dates (keep first).
- Weekly bars: resample daily data to week ending Friday: Open = first, High = max, Low = min, Close = last (of that week's sessions). A holiday-shortened week is still one bar.
- A weekly bar is **complete** once the last session of that week has closed (a Friday close, or the last session before a holiday Friday). Otherwise it is **in progress** (Monday open through today's close).
- Compute indicators on the full available history (recursive EMA/RMA values depend on warm-up). Keep at least 3 years of daily history per ticker.

## 3. Indicator definitions (match TradingView defaults)
- **ATR14**: Wilder RMA of true range, `ewm(alpha=1/14, adjust=False)`; TR = max(H-L, |H-prevC|, |L-prevC|).
- **EMA(n)**: `ewm(span=n, adjust=False)` on Close.
- **Stochastic(14,3,3)**: `raw = 100*(C - LL14)/(HH14 - LL14)`; `K = SMA3(raw)`; `D = SMA3(K)`. If HH14 == LL14, carry the previous value.
- **RSI14**: Wilder; `up = RMA(max(diff,0))`, `dn = RMA(max(-diff,0))`, `RSI = 100 - 100/(1+up/dn)`, RMA = `ewm(alpha=1/14, adjust=False)`.
- **MACD(12,26,9) histogram**: `macd = EMA12 - EMA26`; `signal = EMA9(macd)`; `hist = macd - signal` (EMAs with `adjust=False`).
- **SMA50 (weekly)**: simple mean of the last 50 weekly closes.

## 4. L1: structural bull (weekly gate)
Use completed weekly bars only (exclude the in-progress bar).
```
if completed_weekly_bars < L1_MIN_WEEKS: L1 = NOT_EVALUABLE
sma50 = SMA(weekly_close, 50)
L1 = PASS if sma50[-1] > sma50[-1 - L1_LOOKBACK_WEEKS] else FAIL        # net change over 4 weeks
sma50_4w_pct = sma50[-1] / sma50[-5] - 1                                   # kept in the log; no longer shown on the dashboard, see Part C
```
Net change, not "every week up". Slope only; no price-vs-MA check (dips below the MA and re-crosses do not matter).

## 5. L2: daily signal (every ticker, every EOD, independent of L1)
```
EMAref   = EMA8 if |Close-EMA8| <= |Close-EMA21| else EMA21           # tie -> EMA8
prox_day = |Close - EMAref| <= L2_ATR_K * ATR14
cross_day = (K > D) and (K_prev <= D_prev) and (K <= 30 or D <= 30)    # daily Stoch(14,3,3)
l2_signal(t) = any(prox_day[t-2..t]) and any(cross_day[t-2..t])         # 3-session grace, same as locked spec, no structural input
l2_age(t) = sessions since the most recent day with l2_signal == True (0 on the signal day)
armed(t) = l2_age(t) is not None and l2_age(t) <= ARMED_MAX_AGE
```
Each of the two inputs only needs to be true on some day in the last 3 sessions; they need not coincide.
"Armed" means a daily signal occurred within the last 5 sessions (including today).

**Not yet formalized — see the new `L2_MIN_SESSIONS` requirement under Config above**: this section
has never defined what happens when there isn't enough daily history to compute ATR/EMA/stoch at
all. Add that check here.

## 6. L3: weekly confirmation score (every ticker with L1 == PASS)
Build the **current weekly bar** from Monday's open through today's close (High = max high so far, Low = min low so far, Close = today's close). `prev` = the last completed weekly bar. On the last session of the week the current bar equals the completed bar.
Compute Stoch(14,3,3), RSI14 and MACD hist on the weekly series including the current bar.
```
stoch_pts = L3_W_STOCH if (K_now > K_prev and K_prev <= L3_STOCH_FLOOR) else 0
rsi_pts   = L3_W_RSI   if (RSI_now > RSI_prev) else 0
macd_pts  = L3_W_MACD  if (hist_now > hist_prev) else 0
score = stoch_pts + rsi_pts + macd_pts                                  # 0..5
```
Direction of change only. Do NOT add level conditions (RSI > 50, MACD > 0, MACD cross): they were judged too late. No partial credit for stoch turns from 20 to 50.
`L3_PROVISIONAL = True` unless today is the last session of the week. (Kept in the log; no longer
surfaced as a dashboard badge — see Part C.)

## 7. Combine and status
```
if L1 != PASS:
    status = Monitored
    flags = []
    if L1 == FAIL: flags += [L1_FAILED]
    if L1 == FAIL and armed: flags += [DAILY_SIGNAL_IN]
    if L1 == NOT_EVALUABLE: flags += [NOT_EVALUABLE]
elif armed and score >= L3_QUALIFY_MIN:
    status = Qualified; display score as "4/5" or "5/5"
elif armed:
    status = Developing; label = "Daily signal in, awaiting weekly confirmation"
else:
    status = Developing; label = "Awaiting daily signal"
```
Status is recomputed every EOD. A name can move Qualified to Developing if the in-progress weekly score drops below 4 (repaint) or if the daily signal ages past 5 sessions.

**Known gap, not yet resolved in this pseudocode** (carried over from Part C's design discussion):
`DAILY_SIGNAL_IN` is only ever set inside the `L1 == FAIL` branch, never when `L1 == NOT_EVALUABLE` —
even though L2 is fully independent of L1 and can be armed in either case. Part C's dashboard copy
works around this by reading `armed`/`l2_age` directly at render time rather than through this flags
array, so **no change to this pseudocode is required for the copy to work** — flagging only so the
asymmetry isn't mistaken for a bug elsewhere.

## 8. Badges and dashboard display — superseded by Part C

~~Badges are informational...~~ This section's content (badges, SMA50 display, raw score display) is
**fully superseded by Part C, "Dashboard Row Copy."** Part C is the authoritative spec for what
renders on the dashboard; this section is kept only so the underlying log fields (`SMA50_4W_PCT`,
`L3_PROVISIONAL`, `STOCH_FLATTENING`, the flag keys) are still documented as computed/logged values,
even though several of them are no longer displayed.

- `L3_PROVISIONAL`: still computed and logged; no longer shown on the dashboard.
- `STOCH_FLATTENING` (Developing rows): `K_now <= FLAT_ZONE and abs(K_now - K_prev) <= FLAT_TOL and (K_prev - K_prevprev) <= -FLAT_PRIOR_FALL`, using the same weekly series as L3 (in-progress bar). **Still shown — see Part C for the exact badge treatment ("STOCH FLATTENING").**
- `L1_FAILED` (Monitored rows): the weekly SMA50 is not rising over 4 weeks, so the name is not a Momentum Continuation candidate right now. Shown on every L1-fail row — see Part C for exact copy.
- `DAILY_SIGNAL_IN` (Monitored rows with L1 failing): a daily signal fired within the last 5 sessions even though L1 fails. Shown together with `L1_FAILED` — see Part C for exact copy.
- `NOT_EVALUABLE` (Monitored rows): fewer than 54 completed weekly bars — see Part C for exact copy.
- `SMA50_4W_PCT`: still computed and logged; **dropped from the dashboard entirely** (Part C decision) — judged to add nothing beyond what the Trend ✓/✗ already conveys.

## 9. Daily log (required, background; not shown on the dashboard in v1)
Append one row per ticker per EOD to an append-only table (e.g. SQLite/parquet `mc_v2_daily_log`). Columns:
`date, ticker, close, status, label, score, l1_state, sma50, sma50_4w_ago, sma50_4w_pct, l2_prox_any3, l2_cross_any3, l2_signal, l2_age, armed,
wk_K, wk_K_prev, wk_K_prevprev, wk_D, wk_RSI, wk_RSI_prev, wk_hist, wk_hist_prev, stoch_pts, rsi_pts, macd_pts, l3_provisional, flat_badge`.

**Add for this consolidation**: an `l2_state` (or equivalent) column distinguishing "evaluated,
signal fired/not" from "not enough daily history" — needed once the `L2_MIN_SESSIONS` check (Config,
above) exists.

A nightly job back-fills, once enough sessions exist: `fwd_ret_5, fwd_ret_20, fwd_ret_60` (close to close from the log date) and `mae_60` (lowest low in the next 60 sessions vs the log-date close).
Purpose: validate and retune the provisional parameters (stoch floor, qualify cut, weights, armed age, flattening) from live results instead of hand-picked charts. Also record the sessions between the L2 daily signal and Qualified (confirmation lag).

## 10. Retired from the locked specs
HTF Regime weighted inputs, /5.5 score and tiers, and the weekly-stoch persistence rule; Daily Trigger input 1 (structural trend); the Combine regime-tier columns and High conviction/Speculative tags. Keep the three top-level statuses and the Daily Trigger inputs 2 and 3 (now the L2 daily signal).

Weekly bars are week-ending Friday; "prev" is the prior week.

## 12. Known caveats for the implementer
- Parameters are provisional (see config). Keep them in config, not code.
- The replay anchored the confirmation window to the first signal day of a cluster; the live rolling rule can differ slightly.
- Indicator parity: compute from the full fetched history, not a trimmed window, or RSI/MACD/stoch values drift from TradingView.
- Expect questions; flag any ambiguity back to Satwik rather than guessing, especially around holiday weeks, data gaps and newly listed tickers (< 54 weekly bars = Monitored, NOT_EVALUABLE).

## 13. Status of deferred items
- **Scorecard view** on the dashboard (read-only; hit rate and average forward return by status, score and flattening badge, from the section 9 log). Still deferred — build once the log has about 4 to 8 weeks of rows.
- ~~Ticker-specific dashboard message copy~~ — **no longer deferred.** Fully specified in Part C below.

# Part B — Architecture: L1 / L2 / L3, and why

Decisions closed for v1. Supersedes the HTF Regime box, the structural-trend input of the old Daily
Trigger box, and the old Combine mapping (see "What this retires" below).

## Numbering and names
Layers are numbered in the order they were decided, which does not match the order they were first
drafted — earlier project notes used a different numbering. For the record:

| Final | Name | Old name in earlier notes |
|---|---|---|
| L1 | Structural bull (gate) | L1 (unchanged) |
| L2 | Daily signal | "Daily trigger", numbered L3 |
| L3 | Weekly confirmation score | "Weekly momentum-turn score", numbered L2 |

Naming note: "signal" replaced "trigger" because pulling a trigger means taking the shot, and in this design only
Qualified means take the shot. A daily signal on its own is just the first half of the evidence; the weekly confirmation
score decides whether it becomes Qualified. "Confirmation" replaced "turn" because the weekly layer may later check more
than a turn.

## Diagram

```
              Daily adjusted OHLCV (per ticker, one pass each EOD)
                     |                              |
                     v                              v
        +---------------------------+  +---------------------------+
        | L1 STRUCTURAL BULL (gate) |  | L2 DAILY SIGNAL           |
        | weekly, closed bars only  |  | daily, any of last 3 sess |
        | SMA50 rising over 4 wks   |  | ATR proximity AND         |
        | out: pass / fail / n.e.   |  |   stoch cross (<=30)      |
        +---------------------------+  | out: signal today (bool)  |
              |   \ if pass            +---------------------------+
              |    v                                |
              |  +---------------------------+      |  armed = daily signal in
              |  | L3 WEEKLY CONFIRMATION    |      |  the last 5 sessions
              |  | SCORE                     |      |  (age 0..5)
              |  | weekly, in-progress bar   |      |
              |  | stoch 2 + RSI 2 + MACD 1  |      |
              |  | out: score 0..5           |      |
              |  +---------------------------+      |
              |           |                         |
              v           v                         v
        +-------------------------------------------------------+
        | COMBINE -> STATUS                                     |
        | Qualified = L1 pass AND armed AND L3 score >= 4       |
        +-------------------------------------------------------+
               |                    |                   |
          Qualified            Developing           Monitored
        (shows score 4/5      (L1 pass; daily       (L1 failed or
         or 5/5)               signal or weekly      not evaluable;
                               confirmation due)     flags shown)
```

## What is evaluated, and when

| Layer | Timeframe | Evaluated | Needs | Output |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| L1 | Weekly, completed bars only | Every ticker, every EOD (value changes only when a weekly bar closes, so it can be cached) | >= 54 completed weekly bars, else NOT_EVALUABLE | pass / fail / not evaluable |
| L2 | Daily | Every ticker, every EOD, independent of L1 | ~60 sessions of history for ATR, EMAs, stoch — **needs a formal minimum-session check, see Part A** | signal today (bool), plus days since last signal |
| L3 | Weekly, in-progress bar as of today's close | Every ticker with L1 = pass (always evaluable, since L1 already needs 54 weeks) | >= 40 weekly bars incl. the current one | score 0..5, plus component flags |
| Combine | n/a | After the above | n/a | status, score, badges |

## Combine mapping

| L1 | Armed (L2 signal age <= 5) | L3 score | Status | Label / flags |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pass | yes | >= 4 | Qualified | shows score 4/5 or 5/5 |
| pass | yes | < 4 | Developing | "Daily signal in, awaiting weekly confirmation" |
| pass | no | any | Developing | "Awaiting daily signal" |
| fail | yes | n/a | Monitored | flags `L1_FAILED` + `DAILY_SIGNAL_IN` |
| fail | no | n/a | Monitored | flag `L1_FAILED` |
| not evaluable | any | n/a | Monitored | flag `NOT_EVALUABLE` |

Informational badges (never change status): `L3_PROVISIONAL` (logged, no longer shown — Part C),
`STOCH_FLATTENING` (still shown, Part C), `L1_FAILED`, `DAILY_SIGNAL_IN`, `NOT_EVALUABLE`, and the L1
4-week SMA50 % change (logged, no longer shown — Part C). The score `n/5` shows only on Qualified
rows (Part C) — not on every L1-pass row as originally drafted.

## Decisions (closed) and why
1. **L1 is a hard gate.** A falling weekly SMA50 means "another setup", not Momentum Continuation. A daily signal with L1 failing goes to Monitored, with the `L1_FAILED` and `DAILY_SIGNAL_IN` flags visible.
2. **L3 gates Qualified, not just tags it.** L1 + L2 alone were about a coin flip (91 clusters across 8 names, 51% positive at 20 sessions), so a large Qualified list of weak names was expected. Qualified should stay small and trustworthy; names failing only on L3 stay visible in Developing.
3. **Weekly confirmation may arrive up to 5 sessions after the daily signal.** The weekly confirmation typically lags the daily signal by about 6 sessions, and same-day confirmation qualified only 2 to 4 of 91 clusters. Window tested at 3/5/7/10: 5 kept the best return per cluster; lags of 6 to 10 sessions added weak names.
4. **L3 uses direction of change from a low zone, not levels.** RSI > 50, MACD crosses and similar are too late. Stoch floor 20 (vs 30) was the only variant that beat no-L3 filtering. Weights stoch 2, RSI 2, MACD 1 (MACD is a lagging average).
5. **L3 uses the in-progress weekly bar** (Monday open through today's close) so a confirmation can show before Friday. Repaint is real (6 of 13 five-point AVGO days were gone by Friday), hence the `L3_PROVISIONAL` flag (now logged only, not shown — Part C's call was that this is obvious enough mid-week not to need a badge).
6. **L1 stays strict** (no flat-tolerance band). Known edge: AVGO flipped OFF on a -0.7% change in Nov 2026.
7. **Stoch flattening is a badge, not a score point.** Across 8 names a flat %K after a fall (K <= 30, |change| <= 5) did no better than still-falling (38% positive at 20 sessions vs 51%); only an actual rise stood out (60%). Logged for live review, and still surfaced on the dashboard (Part C).
8. **No extra daily confirmation on L2.** L3 now supplies the selectivity.

## Provisional parameters (single config block; retune from the live log)
stoch floor 20; qualify at score >= 4; weights 2/2/1; armed age <= 5 sessions; flattening tolerance 5 and prior fall 5.

## What this retires from the locked specs
- HTF Regime box: the weighted inputs, the /5.5 score, the Confirmed/Ambiguous/Broken tiers and the weekly-stoch persistence rule.
- Daily Trigger box: input 1 (structural trend: Close >= SMA200, SMA50 > SMA200, SMA50 rising 20 sessions). L1 replaces it. Inputs 2 and 3 (ATR proximity, stoch cross) and the 3-session grace window stay, now called the L2 daily signal.
- Combine box: the regime-tier columns and the High conviction / Speculative tags. Replaced by the table above.
- Unchanged: the three top-level statuses (Qualified, Developing, Monitored).

## Evidence basis and caveats
8 hand-picked names (AVGO, ANET, BJ, CRDO, DRI, COST, ASO, QQQ), about 3 to 4 years of daily data, no clean holdout. CRDO supplies most
60-session gains, so judge on 20-session return and hit rate. Strong trenders (ANET) make almost any entry look good to date; compare against the
name's own baseline. The replay anchored the confirmation window to the first signal day of a cluster; the live rolling "armed" rule is slightly
more permissive when the signal re-fires, which the log will show. Directional evidence, not proof; the live log is how v1 gets validated.

# Part C — Dashboard row copy (UI spec)

**Scope — read this before touching any code.** This is a logic refinement plus a copy/display
change, not a visual redesign. The only UI surface this touches is: (1) the ticker subtext line
(what renders below the ticker/company name on each dashboard row), and (2) the row-level `STOCH
FLATTENING` badge. Nothing else on the dashboard changes — no layout, no other badges, no colors, no
card structure outside those two elements.

## Design brief

The one decision a row needs to drive: *"do I go look at this chart right now or not."* Rows render
grouped under their own status section (Qualified / Developing / Monitored) — the status word is
never repeated inside the row. Everything below that answers "where does this ticker actually
stand," broken into the same three checks a trader mentally runs: is the trend bullish, has a daily
signal fired, is the weekly confirming. No raw scores (except Qualified), no indicator values, no
L1/L2/L3 jargon on screen — those stay in this doc and whatever drill-down view comes later.

## The component model

Every row is built from up to three labeled components, each in one of three states:

| Component | Maps to | States |
|---|---|---|
| **Trend** | L1 structural bull | ✓ pass / ✗ fail / *not enough history yet* |
| **Daily** | L2 daily signal | ✓ armed / ✗ not armed / *not enough history yet* |
| **Weekly** | L3 weekly confirmation, broken into its 3 sub-checks (RSI, MACD, Stoch) | each sub-check ✓ (points earned) or ✗ (not) — shown only when Trend = PASS |

✓/✗ are literal check/cross glyphs, colored (muted teal-green / muted orange — not red/green, and not
a loud alarm color), never a number. "not enough history yet" is spelled out in words, not an icon —
it's a different kind of unresolved than pass/fail.

**Trend and Daily resolve independently of each other** — Daily needs far less history than Trend
(see the `L2_MIN_SESSIONS` requirement in Part A), so for most of a new ticker's life Daily will
already show its real ✓/✗ while Trend still says "not enough history yet." The copy surfaces both at
their own pace rather than forcing one blanket state. **Weekly only ever appears when Trend = PASS**
— by design (L3 is never computed otherwise), so it's omitted entirely on any Monitored row.

## Row templates, by status

**Qualified** (score 4/5 or 5/5, from the existing logic) — the score is kept here, unlike
everywhere else, because it's the one place a number legitimately means "confidence in an
already-made call":
```
{score}/5
```
e.g. `5/5`

**Developing — daily signal in, awaiting weekly confirmation:**
```
Daily ✓ ; Weekly (RSI {✓/✗}, MACD {✓/✗}, Stoch {✓/✗}) ; {remaining}d to confirm
```
`{remaining}` = `ARMED_MAX_AGE (5) − l2_age`, pure display arithmetic on the existing logged field —
no logic change. e.g. `Daily ✓ ; Weekly (RSI ✓, MACD ✗, Stoch ✗) ; 3d to confirm`

**Developing — awaiting daily signal:**
```
Daily ✗ ; Weekly (RSI {✓/✗}, MACD {✓/✗}, Stoch {✓/✗})
```
No "d to confirm" clause — nothing has started counting down yet. e.g.
`Daily ✗ ; Weekly (RSI ✓, MACD ✓, Stoch ✗)`

**Monitored — L1_FAILED only:**
```
Trend ✗
```

**Monitored — L1_FAILED + DAILY_SIGNAL_IN:**
```
Trend ✗ ; Daily ✓ {age}d ago
```
`{age}` = `l2_age` directly. e.g. `Trend ✗ ; Daily ✓ 0d ago`

**Monitored — NOT_EVALUABLE:**
```
Trend (not enough history yet) ; Daily {✓/✗/(not enough history yet)}
```
Daily shows its own real state if the ticker already has enough daily history, even though Trend
doesn't — this is what makes "not enough history yet" self-resolving rather than a dead end. e.g.
`Trend (not enough history yet) ; Daily ✗` once Daily has enough history, or
`Trend (not enough history yet) ; Daily (not enough history yet)` for a brand-new listing.

## Badge

**STOCH FLATTENING** — the only badge kept (an earlier "Provisional" badge was cut: mid-week Weekly
checks rolling is already obvious, so flagging it added nothing). Fires on `STOCH_FLATTENING`, shown
on Developing rows only (either sub-type), as a row-level badge, right-aligned, muted/neutral styling
— light gray/off-white background, gray text, deliberately not an alert color. Exact treatment shown
in the wireframe below.

## What got cut along the way (so it isn't re-litigated)

- **SMA50 4-week % change** — dropped entirely. `Trend ✓/✗` was judged sufficient.
- **Raw L3 score as a number** on any row except Qualified — replaced by the three named sub-checks,
  since a bare fraction didn't say *why* a row was where it was.
- **Provisional badge** — cut.
- **Leading status word in the message** ("Qualified · 5/5") — cut; the section heading already
  carries status.

## Wireframe — every row state, side by side

![Dashboard row copy wireframe, showing Qualified, Developing and Monitored example rows with component-level check and cross marks for Trend, Daily and Weekly, and a muted Stoch Flattening badge on two Developing rows](data:image/png;base64,)

## Implementation requirement (part of this spec, not optional)

L1 (Trend) already has a clean third state, `NOT_EVALUABLE`, wired to a real coded threshold:
`L1_MIN_WEEKS = 54` completed weekly bars. L2 (Daily) has no equivalent today — the architecture in
Part B only says L2 needs "~60 sessions" in prose; there's no `L2_MIN_SESSIONS` constant or check
anywhere that produces an actual "not enough data" output.

**Add that threshold and check for L2, mirroring L1's exactly**: a named config constant (e.g.
`L2_MIN_SESSIONS`, pin the exact number — "~60" is a starting point, not a final value) and a coded
check that produces a real third output, the same shape as L1's `NOT_EVALUABLE`, so the engine can
tell "evaluated, signal didn't fire" apart from "couldn't evaluate yet." The display-layer text for
that state (`(not enough history yet)`) is already decided and identical to Trend's — this is purely
the engine-side gap that lets the dashboard know when to show it. See Part A, sections 1, 5 and 9 for
where this plugs into the existing config/logic/log.

Everything else in Part C — the component states, the templates, the badge, the field mappings
(`l2_age`, `armed`, `rsi_pts`/`macd_pts`/`stoch_pts`, L1's pass/fail/not_evaluable) — is already
produced by the existing logic in Part A and Part B; this part only changes what's displayed from
it, never the logic itself.
